title: af/survey-pending@2
description: One Survey the Surveyor is publishing (ADR-0159 clause 2): a machine-local file beside the Project Store's lock, `pending-surveys/<64 hex>.json`, never in the repository or the log. Written under the lock before any byte of the record is; given the identity of the staged object `pending-surveys/<64 hex>.object` once the record's bytes are durable there, and before that object takes its CAS name; and removed once SurveyRecorded@1 committed. One that outlives its refresh names a record no event references. Version 2 adds the object's birth time and the staging: `af/survey-pending@1` is a superseded version, refused. Canonical JSON, every number decimal text.

survey_id.description: The Survey: the CAS digest of its record's canonical bytes.

bytes.description: The length of the record's canonical bytes, 1 to 1048576.

object.description: The staged object that holds the bytes, stated without following a link once they were durable, before it took its CAS name: its device, inode and birth time in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch, which a rename keeps and a file created later at a reused inode does not share.

born_unix_ns.description: Its birth time, nanoseconds since the Unix epoch; never zero.
